Doublex2 EXP Weekend
Log in this weekend and earn double EXP across every map — the perfect time to push a new character or catch up on levels.
- Event runs Friday 6PM through Sunday midnight (server time)as
- Applies to all PvE and quest EXP gains
- Premium members get an extra +1000% on top
